external_collaboration.partner_name: Mt. Brighton High School Ski Association
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: U of D Jesuit Alpine Ski Racing Team are among the fastest high school athletes. The team competes in the Mt. Brighton High School Ski Association.

Our team embarks on pre-season, off-the-mountain physical conditioning, and by late-December (conditions permitting), the team assembles at Mr. Brighton to begin on-snow training and an introduction to the racing hill. The season culminates with the MBHSSA league championship in early February and the MHSAA regional qualifier in mid-February.

Dr. Malcolm Teasdale P'21 was named Interim Principal on August 4. He brings more than 25 years of educational experience, including 17 in Jesuit schools. He returned to U of D Jesuit as Assistant Principal for the Jesuit Academy during the 2025-2026 school year. He previously held this role from 2008 to 2021. As part of the school safety plan at U of D Jesuit, any parent, guardian, or volunteer, who is working with or chaperoning students at or for U of D Jesuit is required to complete the Protecting God’s Children Workshop offered by the Archdiocese of Detroit. The program should be completed before beginning the assignment. The program is approximately 3 hours in length and offered at various parishes and schools throughout the archdiocese.

OK2SAY is a safety program that allows members of the school community or others to confidentially report tips on potential harm or criminal activities directed at students, school employees, and schools directly to the Michigan State Police.
